retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait framed by a continuous circular ring of sans-serif text that alternates between black and a single accent color.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white afro portrait
text on a circular path around a face
excludeWhen: text needs to be horizontal and linear

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast black and white portrait of a person with a large, rounded hairstyle (afro) that serves as a dark silhouette. The portrait is encircled by a ring of repeating text set in a clean sans-serif font, with specific words highlighted in a vibrant accent color, all against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular text path follows the outer contour of the subject's hair.
High contrast between the deep blacks of the subject and the pure white background.
Rhythmic alternation of text color (black and red) creates visual movement around the circle.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait, cropped at the shoulders, with the head occupying the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and smile, positioned in the lower right quadrant of the hair's silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular text ring clockwise, then settles on the high-contrast facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the corners and around the text ring emphasizes the central circular composition.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white; high saturation for the red accent text.
paletteRestrictions: One high-saturation accent color (e.g., red or orange)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-based differentiation.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, classic grotesque feel of the era.
Provides the necessary clean, neutral geometric structure.
Offers excellent legibility on a curved path.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a person with a large afro hairstyle, centered on a pure white background. The lighting should be dramatic, highlighting the face while keeping the hair as a dark, textured silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a circular path of text around the subject's hair. Use a bold sans-serif font in all caps. Alternate the color of the words between black and a vibrant red. Ensure the text is oriented outwards from the center.

verificationChecks: Does the text alternate colors correctly?

mustAchieve: Deep, rich blacks in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility along the curve
Ensure no artifacts in the white negative space
Verify the balance between the portrait and the text ring
Confirm the high-contrast thresholding doesn't lose facial detail
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + circular sans-serif text path + white negative space = 70s Soul Aesthetic.
